text: I've been to this clinic before with my child, and the doctor was very kind. This time, when I contacted them to reschedule, the admin's reply wasn't very pleasant; it was abrupt. I felt uncomfortable this time and canceled my appointment. I would like them to improve their communication with customers to be more professional.

text:
Today I'd like to recommend a dental clinic in the San Sai Noi area. Parking is available in front of the clinic for two cars and on the street.

This clinic accepts social security benefits and offers 900 baht for dental treatment, with no additional fees. It's very convenient.

You can make an appointment in advance and arrive on time.

The female dentist is gentle and polite.

If you have a chance, come and try our services.
